offers.title: Need for Speed™ Heat Deluxe Edition

items.title: Bullet Girls Phantasia
items.description_source_text: "Bullet Girls Phantasia" is the latest installment of the all-female third person shooter "Bullet Girls" series. This game is a thrilling action-packed game where cute girls shoot assault rifles and bazookas in a world filled with slimes, orcs, and dragons.

items.title: Going Under
items.description_source_text: Going Under is a satirical dungeon crawler about exploring the cursed ruins of failed tech startups. As an unpaid intern in the dystopian city of Neo-Cascadia, you’ll wield office junk as weaponry as you make your way through the offbeat procedural dungeons beneath your company campus.

items.title: Borderlands 2
items.description_source_text: The Ultimate Vault Hunter’s Upgrade lets you get the most out of the Borderlands 2 experience.

offers.title: Borderlands 2 Game of the Year RU

items.title: Jurassic World Evolution 2
items.description_source_text: Jurassic World Evolution 2 is the much-anticipated sequel to Frontier’s highly successful Jurassic World Evolution. This bold new era in the Jurassic World Evolution game franchise builds upon the ground-breaking and immersive 2018 management simulation.

items.title: Trepang2
items.description_source_text: Become the ultimate badass in Trepang2: A gory, action-packed FPS set in the near future. Unleash all hell on your enemies, dodge bullets and leave a trail of destruction in this hardcore and frenetic shooter.

items.title: Heavenly Bodies
items.description_source_text: Wrangle the hands and arms of a 1970s space cosmonaut and push, pull and twist your way through an increasingly precarious range of physically simulated stellar scenarios, where without gravity, nothing is still, nothing is secure, and nothing is simple.

items.title: Borderlands 3
items.description_source_text: The original shooter-looter returns, packing bazillions of guns and a mayhem-fueled adventure! Blast through new worlds and enemies as one of four new Vault Hunters.

items.title: Yes, Your Grace
items.description_source_text: These are troubling times, Your Grace. The petitioners’ petty matters exceed our limited resources, to say nothing of the war. A careful balance must be struck. Your throne awaits.

items.title: Terraformers
items.description_source_text: Terraform Mars in this turn-based colony builder and resource management game with roguelike elements. Explore the planet, develop spectacular cities, spread life and turn the Red Planet into a green one!

items.title: Retrowave
items.description_source_text: Neon lights, palm trees, synthwave, '80s supercars speeding down an endless highway... Welcome to the world of Retrowave!

items.title: Project Warlock
items.description_source_text: Project Warlock is a first-person shooter that fans of Doom, Hexen, and Wolfenstein cannot miss. It serves you an exploding cocktail of bullets, spells, and monsters. Battle through 60 levels of non-stop action, packed with bloodthirsty enemies and challenging bosses.

offers.title: Project Warlock x BRAZILIAN DRUG DEALER 3

items.title: Battlefield 4™
items.description_source_text: Embrace unrivaled destruction in Battlefield 4™. Revel in the glorious chaos of all-out war packed with rewarding, tactical challenges in an interactive environment.

items.title: Battlefield™ 1
items.description_source_text: Battlefield™ 1 takes you back to The Great War, WW1, where new technology and worldwide conflict changed the face of warfare forever.

items.title: Battlefield™ Hardline
items.description_source_text: Strategy. Speed. Story. These are the core pillars of Battlefield™ Hardline, a cops vs. criminals experience unlike any other.

items.title: Beyond: Two Souls
items.description_source_text: A unique psychological action thriller delivered by A-list Hollywood performances by Elliot Page and Willem Dafoe, Beyond: Two Souls takes you on a thrilling journey across the globe as you play out the remarkable life of Jodie Holmes.

items.title: Heavy Rain
items.description_source_text: Experience a gripping psychological thriller filled with innumerable twists and turns. The hunt is on for a murderer known only as the Origami Killer. Four characters, each following their own leads, must take part in a desperate attempt to prevent the killer from claiming a new victim.

items.title: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius - Relics of War
items.description_source_text: Warhammer 40,000: Gladius – Relics of War brings you to a world of terror and violence. Four factions will engage in a brutal war for dominance over the planet’s resources. In the first turn-based 4X strategy game set in Warhammer 40,000 you will lead one of four unique factions.

items.title: Syberia: The World Before
items.description_source_text: Embark on a quest for identity through time, as you piece together the puzzle of two lives.

items.title: Dead Space™ 3
items.description_source_text: Journey across space to the icy planet of Tau Volantis with Isaac Clarke and Sgt. John Carver to discover and destroy the source of the Necromorph outbreak.

items.title: Fahrenheit: Indigo Prophecy Remastered
items.description_source_text: Fahrenheit (known as Indigo Prophecy in North America) was a breakthrough in interactive narrative. This newly remastered edition features updated textures in HD, expanded controller support, and is based on the uncut and uncensored international version of the game.

items.title: Gamedec - Definitive Edition
items.description_source_text: Gamedec is a single-player cyberpunk isometric RPG. You are a game detective, who solves crimes inside virtual worlds. Use your wits to gather info from your witnesses and suspects, getting to the bottom of deceptive schemes. The game continually adapts to your decisions and never judges.

items.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront
items.description_source_text: The STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Ultimate Edition includes the STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Deluxe Edition as well as the STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ Season Pass.

items.title: Tales of the Neon Sea
items.description_source_text: Welcome to a world of intrigue and suspicion. Where humans and robots contend with escalating tensions and mutual distrust. And where gangster felines scheme their way to the top of the food chain. Welcome to the Tales of the Neon Sea!

offers.title: Tales of the Neon Sea - Complete Edition

items.title: 112 Operator
items.description_source_text: Manage emergency services in any city in the world! Take calls and dispatch rescue forces. Handle difficult situations, now depending on the weather, and traffic. Help the citizens through cataclysms and natural disasters, becoming a better emergency number operator every day!

items.title: Ash of Gods: The Way
items.description_source_text: Solve tactical puzzles in constantly changing battles and overcome circumstances that are NEVER in your favor. Defend your commander, win duels, capture points, experiment with your strategy to defeat a superior enemy, and make decisions that affect your story.

items.title: Dragon Age II: Ultimate Edition
items.description_source_text: You are Hawke, a refugee seeking to escape the darkspawn-plagued land of Ferelden and become Champion of Kirkwall. Rise to power and fight epic battles while making decisions that determine the course of civilization.

items.title: Dragon Age: Origins - Ultimate Edition
items.description_source_text: Explore a stunning world, make complex moral choices, and engage in bone-crushing combat against massive and terrifying creatures. The Ultimate Edition includes Dragon Age: Origins, Dragon Age: Origins - Awakening and all nine content packs.

items.title: Mass Effect (2007)
items.description_source_text: As Commander Shepard, you lead an elite squad on a heroic, action-packed adventure throughout the galaxy.

items.title: Nioh: Complete Edition
items.description_source_text: Ready to die? Experience the newest brutal action game from Team NINJA and Koei Tecmo Games. In the age of samurai, a lone traveler lands on the shores of Japan. He must fight his way through the vicious warriors and supernatural Yokai that infest the land in order to find that which he seeks.

items.title: Remnant: From the Ashes
items.description_source_text: The world has been thrown into chaos by an ancient evil from another dimension. As one of the last remnants of humanity, you must set out alone or alongside up to two other survivors to face down hordes of deadly enemies to try to carve a foothold, rebuild, and retake what was lost.

items.title: Dungeons of Hinterberg
items.description_source_text: Discover the magic and lore of the Alps in this acclaimed Action Adventure. Forge relationships with locals to help you solve puzzles, battle monsters and uncover secrets of the legendary Dungeons of Hinterberg!

items.title: REMNANT II®
items.description_source_text: REMNANT II® pits survivors of humanity against new deadly creatures and god-like bosses across terrifying worlds. Play solo or co-op with two other friends to explore the depths of the unknown to stop an evil from destroying reality itself.

items.title: Titan Souls
items.description_source_text: Between our world and the world beyond lie the Titan Souls, the spiritual source of all living things. Scattered amongst the ruins and guarded by the idle titans charged with their care, a solitary hero armed with a single arrow is assembling shards of the Titan Soul in a quest for truth and power.

items.title: Unravel
items.description_source_text: Unravel is a physics-based puzzle platformer. Yarny, a character made from a single thread of yarn, must embark on a larger than life adventure.

items.title: Unravel Two
items.description_source_text: When you cut ties to the past, new bonds form. Build relationships with other Yarnys in local co-op or as a single player, fostering friendship and support as you journey together.

items.title: Alfred Hitchcock - Vertigo
items.description_source_text: Can you trust your own mind? Immerse yourself in a psychological thriller of a new kind, playing with the limits between reality and fantasy. Freely inspired by Alfred Hitchcock’s universe.

items.title: Blood Bowl: Chaos Edition (Classic)
items.description_source_text: This bonecrunching sport features 23 playable races, each with its own style, vicious moves, rankings & more!

items.title: Bomber Crew
items.description_source_text: Chocks away! Bomber Crew is a strategic simulation game, where picking the right crew and keeping your bomber in tip top shape is the difference between completing your mission or losing it all! USAAF DLC NOW AVAILABLE! FLY THE ICONIC AMERICAN BOMBER!

items.title: Call to Arms - Basic Edition
items.description_source_text: Call to Arms offers an innovative mix of real-time strategy and 3rd, as well as 1st person controls. Set in the time of modern warfare, the game offers realistically modeled vehicles and heavy weaponry. Command your troops to victory or fight by yourself in the 3rd or 1st person action mode.

items.title: Factory Town
items.description_source_text: Build, automate, and optimize a giant factory on 3D terrain using conveyor belts, trains, chutes, pipes, and airships. Sell your goods to nearby villages to expand their borders, increase happiness, and unlock even better technology!

items.title: Hand of Fate 2
items.description_source_text: A new hero rises to challenge the Dealer in Hand of Fate 2! Master a living boardgame of infinitely replayable quests - unlock new cards, build your adventure, then defeat your foes in brutal real-time combat! Draw your cards, play your hand and discover your fate!

items.title: Loren The Amazon Princess
items.description_source_text: You're not the chosen hero: you're her servant. Build your character and fight beside Princess Loren in a choice-driven fantasy RPG with tactical turn-based battles, party customization, branching relationships, and multiple romance options.

items.title: Serial Cleaner
items.description_source_text: Slip on your flares, grab your shades and hop in your station wagon, it's time to work… as a professional mob cleaner. In this stylish award winning 2D action-stealth game you have to make sure you get in, clean up and get out without leaving a trace - Queue the funky 70s inspired soundtrack!

items.title: Tempest: Pirate Action RPG
items.description_source_text: Tempest is a Pirate Open World Action RPG where you rove the seas across three continents filled with dozens of colonies and forts, hundreds of quests and countless ships to plunder. Customize your ship, trade, challenge fellow pirates and face mythical monsters such as the Kraken and Leviathan!

items.title: Toukiden 2
items.description_source_text: Slayers! Go forth and eradicate the Oni menace! Experience the latest hunting action game featuring a dynamic targeted destruction system! The latest installment in the hunting action series "Toukiden". From the battlefield to the village that serves as your base of operations, the game takes place in a vast "open world". Explore the vast world for yourself, and enjoy hunting action from an entirely new perspective.

items.title: XIII - Classic
items.description_source_text: You are the victim of a conspiracy! The FBI, CIA and a group of murderers are chasing you. XIII… This strange tattoo and the key of a safe are your only clues to survive and claim your innocence! It's time to gear up and eliminate your ennemies!

items.title: Need for Speed™ Payback
items.description_source_text: Set in the underworld of Fortune Valley, you and your crew were divided by betrayal and reunited by revenge to take down The House, a nefarious cartel that rules the city’s casinos, criminals and cops. In this corrupt gambler’s paradise, the stakes are high and The House always wins.

offers.title: Need for Speed™ Payback - Deluxe Edition

items.title: Rogue Heroes: Ruins of Tasos
items.description_source_text: Rogue Heroes is a topdown, roguelite adventure game inspired by the Zelda franchise. Play solo or team up with your friends to combat procedurally generated dungeons and take down the evil Titans that threaten to overwhelm the land of Tasos!

items.title: Svarog's Dream
items.description_source_text: Awaken as a soul from the Underworld. Discover who you are and explore an ever-changing open world full of mystery. Battle beasts and gods, or forge alliances with them. Die and be reborn in this adventure.

items.title: 20XX
items.description_source_text: 20XX is a roguelike action platformer that you can play with a friend. Jump and shoot your way through ever-changing levels, collect awesome new powers, and battle mighty bosses in the name of saving the human race maybe!

items.title: Haydee
items.description_source_text: "Haydee" is a hardcore old-style metroidvania mixed with modern-day third person shooter and platformer mechanics. As well as a sexy character.

items.title: Hero of the Kingdom
items.description_source_text: Step into this lovely adventuring RPG and embrace a serene journey at your own pace. Gather supplies, patiently overcome obstacles, and help those in need. Discover a heartwarming tale where an ordinary boy saves his father.

items.title: Hue
items.description_source_text: Hue is a vibrant, award-winning puzzle-adventure, where you alter the world by changing its background colour.

items.title: Just Die Already
items.description_source_text: Just Die Already is an old people mayhem sandbox game created by the designers of Goat Simulator. You are old and angry and you've just been kicked out of your retirement home. How will you survive in a world that wants you to Just Die Already?

items.title: Prodigal
items.description_source_text: Journey through a vibrant world fighting vicious monsters, exploring puzzling dungeons, and collecting magical artifacts. Unravel the mysteries of Vann's Point and bond with all of its curious townsfolk!

items.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II
items.description_source_text: Be the hero in the ultimate STAR WARS™ battle fantasy with STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition!

offers.title: STAR WARS™ Battlefront™ II: Celebration Edition

items.title: Tavern Master
items.description_source_text: Tavern Master is all about managing your medieval tavern. You start with a very small room, couple of benches and tables and build your way up to a huge successful tavern with a kitchen, rooms for guests, group of loyal staff and much more!

items.title: 911 Operator
items.description_source_text: Game about the difficult work of people that manage emergency lines and services. Answer incoming calls and react properly - give first aid instructions, advise, dispatch correct number of firemen / police / ambulances, or sometimes - just ignore the call. Play on ANY CITY in the world!

items.title: American Fugitive
items.description_source_text: FREE UPDATE; STATE OF EMERGENCY, OUT NOW! Framed for your father’s murder, you’ll need to do whatever it takes to unveil the real culprit. Tackle thrilling missions for the criminal underworld - just don’t let the cops track you down!

items.title: Cyber Manhunt
items.description_source_text: Cyber Manhunt is a story-oriented puzzle game focusing on big data, hacking, citizen privacy, and social workers. It focuses on social issues such as cyber violence and privacy breaches.

items.title: Dead Space™ 2
items.description_source_text: Three years after the Necromorph infestation aboard the USS Ishimura, Isaac Clarke awakens from a coma, confused, disoriented, and on a space station called The Sprawl. Explore this world and its zero-g environments to discover the truth about the Unitology and its role in the Necromorph epidemic.

items.title: Event[0]
items.description_source_text: Event[0] is a sci-fi narrative exploration game where you build a relationship with a lonely spaceship computer to get home to Earth.

items.title: Fishing: Barents Sea
items.description_source_text: Commercial fishing on the Barents Sea! Take the helm of your very own fishing boat in Fishing: Barents Sea and explore the vastness of the Barents Sea in search for the best fishing zones. Start out small and earn officially licensed Scanmar Equipment and the officially licensed Hermes trawler.

items.title: Hand of Fate
items.description_source_text: Deckbuilding comes to life in Hand of Fate! An infinitely replayable series of quests - earn new cards, build your deck, then try to defeat it! In a cabin at the end of the world, the game of life and death is played. Draw your cards, play your hand, and discover your fate.

items.title: Human Fall Flat
items.description_source_text: Human Fall Flat is a hilarious, light-hearted platformer set in floating dreamscapes that can be played solo or with up to 8 players online. Free new levels keep its vibrant community rewarded.

items.title: Manual Samuel - Last Tuesday Edition
items.description_source_text: Wealthy, handsome, and... dead? Samuel strikes a deal with Death for one last shot at life, but only if he can survive a day doing everything manually. Blink, breathe, walk, and work - Guide Sam in this darkly humorous and brutally difficult adventure!

items.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition
items.description_source_text: Ready the Peashooters and prepare for the craziest, funniest shooter in the universe: Plants vs. Zombies Garden Warfare 2.

offers.title: Plants vs. Zombies™ Garden Warfare 2: Deluxe Edition

items.title: 10 Second Ninja X
items.description_source_text: 10 SECOND NINJA X is a hardcore sidescroller. You're a ninja, there are robots, you've got ten seconds to destroy them all. Get three star ratings, climb leaderboards, discover secrets and stop Captain Greatbeard.

items.title: Batman - The Telltale Series
items.description_source_text: Enter the fractured psyche of Bruce Wayne and discover the powerful and far-reaching consequences of your choices as the Dark Knight.

items.title: Batman: The Enemy Within - The Telltale Series
items.description_source_text: In this latest chapter from the award-winning studio behind Batman - The Telltale Series, both Bruce Wayne and Batman will be forced into precarious new roles. The Riddler has returned to terrorize Gotham City, but his gruesome puzzles merely foreshadow an even greater crisis.

offers.title: Batman: The Enemy Within - The Telltale Series

items.title: Dreams of Desire: Definitive Edition
items.description_source_text: Dreams of Desire: Definitive Edition is an Adult Visual Novel about power, corruption and mystery where your choices really matter until the very end. What you will find is steaming hot sex with a variety of stunning women, loveable characters, multiple endings and an intriguing story.

items.title: Fallback
items.description_source_text: Lead the rebellion in an epic rogue-like adventure. Guide your jet-pack equipped post-apocalyptic volunteers through a labyrinthine underground complex by jumping, dodging, and battling against robot minions (and masters) to get to the surface — and bring life back to the scorched Earth.

items.title: Glass Masquerade
items.description_source_text: Welcome to Glass Masquerade - an artistic puzzle game inspired by Art Deco & stained glass artisans of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to unveil clocks and themes exhibited by various cultures of the world at the 'International Times Exhibition'

items.title: Glass Masquerade 2: Illusions
items.description_source_text: Welcome to the Glass Masquerade sequel - an artistic puzzle game inspired by stained glass artisans and Wonderland depictions of the 20th century. You need to combine hidden glass pieces to solve every riddle and free yourself from a tangled dream.

items.title: Kanjozoku Game レーサー Online Street Racing & Drift
items.description_source_text: 90s Osaka Kanjo Night Street Racing and Drift Online with True JDM Cars, Online PvP, Engine, Body and Suspension Tuning!

items.title: Lorn's Lure
items.description_source_text: An android is led through a vast structure by a glitch in his visual system. Lorn's Lure is an atmospheric narrative first-person platformer with novel climb-anything mechanics and modernized retro 3D graphics.

items.title: SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell
items.description_source_text: Like a bastard child of Quake 3 and Super Meat Boy, SEUM: Speedrunners from Hell is truly hardcore and focuses on speed and fast reaction.

items.title: The Culling Of The Cows
items.description_source_text: The Culling Of The Cows is a side-scrolling shooter / tower defence game. You will take the role of Sammy, a soliloquizing schizophrenic farmer with a self prophesied mission to lay waste to the disease spreading over his farm.

items.title: Tyrant's Realm
items.description_source_text: Tyrant's Realm is a roguelite action-adventure inspired by classic PS1 visuals. Explore procedurally generated dark fantasy worlds, battling through dangers that evolve with each run. Death is not the end, as the night is still young.

items.title: Dead Space (2008)
items.description_source_text: You are Isaac Clarke, an engineer on the spacecraft USG Ishimura. You're not a warrior. You're not a soldier. You are, however, the last line of defense for the remaining living crew.

items.title: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 4.1 The Shadow of New Despair
items.description_source_text: It's a fight for the future of the planet between the Ravagers, a merciless swarm of alien invaders, and the Earth Defense Force (EDF) in this third-person shooter.Play as four different classes in over 80 missions with a range of 800 weapons at your disposal.Co-op play supported.

offers.title: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 4.1 The Shadow of New Despair

items.title: Escape Simulator
items.description_source_text: First-person puzzler you can play solo or in an online co-op. Explore a set of highly interactive escape rooms. Move furniture, pick up and examine everything, smash pots and break locks! Play thousands of community-made rooms through the level editor.

items.title: Halluci-Sabbat of Koishi
items.description_source_text: Touhou Project, Komeiji Koishi's Action Game, with collision between sword and magic! Help Marisa hold a Sabbat of witches, and explore the way of treasure hunt with wisdom and strength. On the day of the war, there is the glory of death and no shame of life.

offers.title: 幻恋の夜宴: ハルーシサノバこいし ~ Halluci-Sabbat of Koishi

items.title: Love of Magic
items.description_source_text: Love of Magic is an erotic Urban Fantasy Sandbox RPG. Master your Magic. Find true Love. Discover your Destiny.

items.title: Mana Spark
items.description_source_text: A challenging action RPG with deep souls-like combat and rogue-like elements. Explore a dreadful dungeon and fight smart enemies that will plan and collaborate between themselves to defeat you.

items.title: Perennial Order
items.description_source_text: Perennial Order is a 2D plant horror boss rush with challenging one-hit-death combat. Set in an atmospheric Dark Age world plagued by nature-infested horrors, explore a lore-filled and eldritch land alone or in two player co-op, all in a realistic painterly style.

items.title: A Guidebook of Babel
items.description_source_text: A narrative-driven puzzle adventure game with the butterfly effect at its core. Board the Babel, a mysterious cruise ship that takes you on a whimsical journey to the afterlife. Use a special pen to help fellow travelers fulfill their wishes by rewriting the past, changing how the future unfolds.

offers.title: 旅人苏菲亚 X 巴别号漫游指南 限时折扣

items.title: BROK the InvestiGator
items.description_source_text: An innovative adventure mixed with beat 'em up and RPG elements. In a grim world where animals have replaced mankind, what kind of detective will you be?

items.title: Darkstone
items.description_source_text: Lord Draak's henchmen are spreading chaos in Uma. Are you going to let them get away with it?

items.title: Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines
items.description_source_text: "Endless Monday: Dreams and Deadlines" - In this short story from the Endless Monday, Penny, a mild-mannered corporate grunt, spends a weekend at the office in an effort to finish her project on time while overcoming distractions from coworkers, space aliens, imaginary friends, and herself.

items.title: Garfield Kart
items.description_source_text: Join Garfield and his friends in the funniest fast and fur-ious game! What character do you want to play with? Garfield, Odie, Jon, Nermal... you choose! Take part in no-holds-barred crazy races.

items.title: Mosaique Neko Waifus 4
items.description_source_text: Hentai puzzle with elements of RPG and meaningful dialogue choices. Flirt with all the Neko girls!

items.title: The Vagrant
items.description_source_text: Guide Vivian the Vagrant, through vibrant and dynamic landscapes while hacking and slashing a path from a quiet coastal village through mysterious forests, haunted castles, and wrecked battlegrounds. When the endless barrage of enemies have been vanquished, what solace will be left for our hero?

items.title: Whisker Wanderlust: The Mosaic of Souls
items.description_source_text: Welcome to "Stray of Lost Cat", a story centered around a peculiar little feline. Follow the kitten's journey as it escapes the pursuit of "Meowdes" while collecting soul fragments, striving to reunite with its beloved owner.

offers.title: Whisker Wanderlust: The Mosaic of Souls

items.title: Golf It!
items.description_source_text: Embark on an exciting journey with Golf It! Seize your putter, rally your friends, and immerse yourself in an epic minigolf adventure. Conquer countless courses, create lasting memories, and refine your skills to emerge as the ultimate minigolf champion. Your thrilling golfing odyssey begins here!

items.title: Kemono Teatime
items.description_source_text: Relax in the world of Kemono Teatime, where animal ears are a normal part of everyday life. Here in Melodius, you can whip up whatever blends of tea you desire in your favorite cafe as you play through an adorable story. Come now and live out your bestest and cutest life—down to the last drop.

items.title: Organs Please
items.description_source_text: A dark and satirical management sim, where you take control of a recycling factory with a twist: it recycles humans. Your job is to decide who gets to escape our dying planet in a cozy spaceship and who sacrifices their blood, sweat and tears for humanity. Literally.

items.title: THE CORRIDOR
items.description_source_text: THE CORRIDOR is a 20-30 minute experience about the relationship between player and game.

items.title: RATSHAKER™
items.description_source_text: RATSHAKER™ is the fun and quirky solution to all your rat problems! Hold on to the RAT, shake your arm, and watch life’s problems disappear! How far can you go?

items.title: Luma Island
items.description_source_text: Get ready to explore, farm, fish, mine, craft, and raise magical Lumas as you solve puzzles and embark on quests across Luma Island. Play solo, or team up with friends in 1-4 player online co-op. Choose relaxing Cozy, challenging Adventure, or epic Hero mode to match your mood and playstyle.

items.title: Escape Simulator 2
items.description_source_text: Sequel to the best-selling escape room game, brings a fresh take on first-person puzzles with a variety of new rooms to explore solo or with friends. Solve intricate puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, or craft your own escape rooms with Room Editor 2.0.

items.title: METAL EDEN
items.description_source_text: An adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. A HYPER UNIT ASKA is sent on a suicide mission to rescue citizens' COREs from MOEBIUS, an orbital city turned into a deadly trap. Dive into cybernetic warfare, face the ENGINEERS, and uncover the secrets of METAL EDEN.

items.title: My Friend Pedro
items.description_source_text: My Friend Pedro is a violent ballet about friendship, imagination, and one man’s struggle to obliterate anyone in his path at the behest of a sentient banana.

items.title: MELTY BLOOD: TYPE LUMINA
items.description_source_text: This is the latest addition to the series of 2D fighting games based on TYPE-MOON's visual novel, Tsukihime. The curtain rises once more on dramatic battles played out with familiar characters from Tsukihime: A Piece of Blue Glass Moon.

items.title: Session: Skate Sim
items.description_source_text: Made by and for skaters, the dual stick controls faithfully reproduce your feet on the skateboard for an ultra-realistic experience. Try out real-life iconic skate spots, customise your skater and equipment with items from the top brands

items.title: SpeedRunners
items.description_source_text: Cut-throat multiplayer running game that pits 4 players against each other, locally and/or online. Run, jump, swing around, and use devious weapons and pick-ups to knock opponents off-screen! One of the most competitive games you'll ever play.

items.title: Trinity Fusion
items.description_source_text: Three fractured realities. One collapsing multiverse. Fast, fluid combat in a dark sci-fi Roguevania where each run begins in a separate universe — then lets you fuse your parallel selves, powers, and worlds to create brutal, ever-evolving builds.

items.title: Cassette Beasts
items.description_source_text: Collect awesome monsters to use during turn-based battles in this open-world RPG, now with online multiplayer mode. Combine any two monster forms using Cassette Beasts’ Fusion System to create unique and powerful new ones!

items.title: Hitman: Absolution™
items.description_source_text: The original assassin is back! Betrayed by the Agency and hunted by the police, Agent 47 finds himself pursuing redemption in a corrupt and twisted world.

items.title: The Devil Within: Satgat
items.description_source_text: Join Kim Rip, a Royal Guard whose humanity is gradually slipping away, on a thrilling 2.5D action-adventure platforming journey in 'The Devil Within: Satgat'. Uncover the mysteries of a desolate realm as you engage in stylish battles against formidable foes.

items.title: Loddlenaut
items.description_source_text: Play as an interstellar custodian sent to clean up a polluted ocean planet. Pick up trash, explore the vibrant waters, and take care of axolotl-like alien creatures!

items.title: The Last Gas Station
items.description_source_text: In a world where electric cars reign supreme, you are now the owner of an old gas station out in the wilderness. Establish trade, develop your business and uncover the secret of this strange place in the compact gas station simulator.

items.title: Lil Gator Game
items.description_source_text: Embark on an adorable adventure, discover new friends and uncover everything the island has to offer. Climb, Swim, Glide and slide your way into the hearts of the many different characters you meet on your travels!

items.title: Downwell
items.description_source_text: Downwell is a curious game about a young person venturing down a well in search of untold treasures with only his Gunboots to protect him.

items.title: Vasilisa and Baba Yaga
items.description_source_text: An adventure game based on the Russian folktale "Vasilisa the Beautiful". A scary story about the journey to the mistress of the forbidden forest for magical powers.

items.title: FAKEBOOK
items.description_source_text: Point-and-click mystery adventure on the virtual Social Media! Find secrets hidden by family, friends, companies, and idols.

items.title: SUMMERHOUSE
items.description_source_text: A tiny building game about beautiful lived-in houses. No rules or restrictions, just pure creativity.

items.title: Wall World
items.description_source_text: Explore the mysterious Wall World on your giant robospider: mine for valuable resources, upgrade your equipment to fight off hordes of monsters, and discover exotic biomes in-between attacks. Will you be able to survive and learn the secrets of the Wall World?

items.title: Planes, Bullets and Vodka
items.description_source_text: Fly through danger filled procedurally generated tunnels, avoiding thousands of enemies, on this throwback to the golden age of arcade games.

items.title: Watch_Dogs® 2
items.description_source_text: Welcome to San Francisco. Play as Marcus, a brilliant young hacker, and join the most notorious hacker group, DedSec. Your objective: execute the biggest hack of history.

items.title: Far Cry® 6
items.description_source_text: Lead the revolution in this first-person open world guerrilla shooter. Fight with improvised weapons, travel however you can, and build your rebel network to take down Castillo's regime.

items.title: Greak: Memories of Azur
items.description_source_text: Greak: Memories of Azur is a single-player puzzle platformer adventure. Azur is under threat from an enemy attack who have control of strange creatures infecting the land. Take on the role of three siblings: Greak, Adara and Raydel and utilize their unique abilities to escape the invasion together.

items.title: Riders Republic
items.description_source_text: Jump into a massive multiplayer playground! Bike, ski, snowboard, or wingsuit across an open world sports paradise where the rules are yours to make or break.

items.title: The Quarry
items.description_source_text: When the sun goes down on the last night of summer camp, nine teenage counselors are plunged into an unpredictable night of horror. The only thing worse than the blood-drenched locals and creatures hunting them are the unimaginable choices you must make to help them survive.

items.title: Assassin's Creed® Origins
items.description_source_text: Explore Ancient Egypt in this action-adventure game. Battle powerful enemies, unveil conspiracies, and discover the origin story of the Assassin’s Brotherhood.

items.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided
items.description_source_text: You play as Adam Jensen, an experienced covert operative operating in a world that despises his kind: augmented humans. Choose from an arsenal of state-of-the-art weapons and augmentations to build your playstyle, and decide who you'll trust, to unravel a vast worldwide conspiracy.

offers.title: Deus Ex: Mankind Divided - A Criminal Past

items.title: Far Cry® 5
items.description_source_text: Fight a fanatical cult in this open world FPS. Engage in intense combat, free hostile territory, recruit loyal followers and animal allies, and liberate Hope County solo or in full 2-player co-op.

items.title: Ni no Kuni™ II: Revenant Kingdom
items.description_source_text: Join the young king Evan as he sets out on an epic quest to found a new kingdom and, with the help of some new friends, unite his world, saving its people from a terrible evil.

offers.title: Ni no Kuni II: Revenant Kingdom - The Prince's Edition

items.title: The Escapists
items.description_source_text: The Escapists provides players the opportunity of experiencing a light-hearted insight into everyday prison life with the main objective being that of escaping!

offers.title: The Escapists + The Escapists: The Walking Dead Deluxe

items.description_source_text: DRAGON BALL FighterZ is born from what makes the DRAGON BALL series so loved and famous: endless spectacular fights with its all-powerful fighters.

items.description_source_text: Why have friends if not to play Golf... With Your Friends! Nothing is out of bounds as you take on courses filled with fast paced, exciting, simultaneous mini golf for up to 12 players!

offers.title: Golf With Your Friends - Ultimate Edition

items.title: Steep™
items.description_source_text: Ride a massive open world across the Alps, where the powder is always fresh and the run never ends. Defy and master the mountain alone or with friends on skis, wingsuits, snowboards and paragliders. Record and share your best stunts.

items.title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut
items.description_source_text: You play Adam Jensen, an ex-SWAT specialist who's been handpicked to oversee the defensive needs of one of America's most experimental biotechnology firms. When a black ops team breaks in and kills the very scientists you were hired to protect, everything you thought you knew about your job changes.

offers.title: Deus Ex: Human Revolution - Director's Cut

items.title: Far Cry® New Dawn
items.description_source_text: Dive into a transformed vibrant post-apocalyptic Hope County, Montana, 17 years after a global nuclear catastrophe. Lead the fight against the Highwaymen, as they seek to take over the last remaining resources.

items.title: One Piece Burning Blood
items.description_source_text: The game that all One Piece fans have been waiting for. One Piece Burning Blood is a dynamic and colourful new fighting game featuring the world’s most famous pirate: Monkey D. Luffy.

offers.title: ONE PIECE BURNING BLOOD GOLD Edition

items.title: Painkiller Hell & Damnation
items.description_source_text: Evil has returned! Demonic powers are manifesting themselves as a myriad of dark creatures, fighting over the fates of imprisoned souls caught in Purgatory.

items.title: Pathfinder: Kingmaker — Enhanced Plus Edition
items.description_source_text: Pathfinder: Kingmaker - Enhanced Plus Edition is the first isometric party-based cRPG set in the Pathfinder fantasy universe. Enjoy a classic RPG experience inspired by games like Baldur's Gate, Fallout 1 and 2 and Arcanum. Explore and conquer the Stolen Lands and make them your kingdom!

items.title: Tom Clancy’s The Division™
items.description_source_text: A tactical open world third-person shooter set in New York after a deadly pandemic. Team up or go solo to restore order against deadly factions, secure loot, and conquer high-risk endgame challenges.

items.title: Watch_Dogs™
items.description_source_text: In today's hyper-connected world, Chicago operates under ctOS, the most advanced computer network in America.

items.title: Assassin's Creed® Syndicate
items.description_source_text: London, 1868. Lead your underworld organization in the midst of the Industrial Revolution to break the corrupt stranglehold on the city in a visceral adventure filled with action, intrigue, and brutal combat.

items.title: Assassin's Creed® Unity
items.description_source_text: Paris, 1789. In this action-adventure game, experience the French Revolution through the eyes of Arno Dorian. Become an Assassin and expose the true powers behind the Revolution for the fate of a nation.

items.title: Bionic Bay
items.description_source_text: A scientist uses a unique teleportation instrument to escape an ancient biomechanical world filled with imaginative technology, deadly traps, and hidden secrets.

items.title: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
items.description_source_text: Step into the boots of Grayson Hunt after a crash landing on an old resort planet forces him to make a hard choice: survival or revenge. Execute masterful kills with Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition’s unique combat system that rewards you for performing the most creative and deadly kills imaginable.

items.title: ENDLESS Legend™
items.description_source_text: ENDLESS Legend™ is a 4X turn-based fantasy strategy game by the creators of ENDLESS Space™ and Dungeon of the ENDLESS™. Control every aspect of your civilization as you struggle to save your homeworld Auriga. Create your own Legend!

items.title: Far Cry® 4
items.description_source_text: Fight to liberate a war-torn Himalayan region in this open world FPS. Wield a deadly arsenal, dominate land and sky with gyrocopters and war elephants, and take on enemy territory solo or in co-op.

items.title: ONE PIECE World Seeker
items.description_source_text: Leave your compass behind and join Luffy as he embarks on a brand new action-packed adventure where you can experience the powers of the legendary Gum-Gum fruit to uncover hidden secrets on an original, never-before-seen island!

offers.title: ONE PIECE WORLD SEEKER Deluxe Edition

items.title: Police Simulator: Patrol Officers
items.description_source_text: Welcome to Brighton! Join the police force of this fictitious American city and experience the day to day life of a police officer.

items.title: Red Faction Guerrilla Re-Mars-tered
items.description_source_text: Red Faction: Guerrilla re-defines the limits of destruction-based game-play with a huge open-world, fast-paced guerrilla-style combat, and true physics-based destruction.

items.title: Scorn
items.description_source_text: Scorn is an atmospheric first-person horror adventure game set in a nightmarish universe of odd forms and somber tapestry.

items.title: South Park™: The Stick of Truth™

offers.title: South Park™: The Stick of Truth™

items.title: Styx: Shards of Darkness
items.description_source_text: Styx returns in a new stealth adventure! Explore and master huge open environments, sneak past or assassinate new enemies and bosses, and experiment with the new array of lethal abilities and weapons in our goblin assassin's arsenal.

items.title: TOEM: A Photo Adventure
items.description_source_text: Set off on a delightful expedition and use your photographic eye to uncover the mysteries of the magical TOEM in this hand-drawn adventure game. Chat with quirky characters, solve their problems by snapping neat photos, and make your way through a relaxing landscape!

items.title: Worms W.M.D
items.description_source_text: Join the fight and command your worm warriors into battle in the iconic 2D arcade artillery shooter where serious strategy and silly weaponry decide who swims or sinks.

items.title: Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey
items.description_source_text: Survive your evolution in Neogene Africa starting 10 million years ago. Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey is a third-person open world survival game where you Explore, Expand, and Evolve to advance your clan to the next generation in the exciting new adventure from Panache Digital Games.

items.title: Arcade Spirits
items.description_source_text: Arcade Spirits is a romantic visual novel that follows an alternative timeline where the 1983 video game crash never occurred. It's 20XX and you've just started a new job at the Funplex game arcade. Who will you meet along the way? Will you find the romance you're seeking?

items.title: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
items.description_source_text: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

items.title: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE
items.description_source_text: DRAGON BALL XENOVERSE revisits famous battles from the series through your custom Avatar and other classic characters. New features include the mysterious Toki Toki City, new gameplay mechanics, new animations and many other amazing features!

items.title: F1® Manager 2024
items.description_source_text: Lead your team to glory in F1® Manager 2024. A new Formula 1® season has arrived, and with it, the most comprehensive F1® management experience to date. Build a legacy with one of 10 official F1® constructors or create your own team for the very first time.

items.title: Far Cry® Primal
items.description_source_text: The award-winning Far Cry franchise returns with its innovative open world gameplay, bringing together massive beasts, breathtaking environments, and unpredictable savage encounters. Welcome to the Stone Age, a time of danger and adventure.

items.title: Gloomhaven
items.description_source_text: Lead your band of mercenaries in the land of Gloomhaven, work with unsavoury individuals, shape the fate of the region, fight your way through horrific places and get rich or die trying in this ruthless Tactical-RPG.

items.title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition
items.description_source_text: Niko Bellic, Johnny Klebitz and Luis Lopez all have one thing in common - they live in the worst city in America. Liberty City worships money and status, and is heaven for those who have them and a living nightmare for those who don't.

offers.title: Grand Theft Auto IV: The Complete Edition

items.title: Kerbal Space Program
items.description_source_text: In Kerbal Space Program, take charge of the space program for the alien race known as the Kerbals. You have access to an array of parts to assemble fully-functional spacecraft that flies (or doesn’t) based on realistic aerodynamic and orbital physics. Launch your Kerbal crew into orbit and beyond (while keeping them alive) to explore moons and planets in the Kerbol solar system, constructing bases and space stations to expand the reach of your expedition.

items.title: Legend of Keepers: Career of a Dungeon Manager
items.description_source_text: Legend of Keepers is the perfect mix between Dungeon Defender and Roguelite. You have been hired as a dungeon manager by the Dungeons Company. Your job is simple: protect their dungeons!

items.title: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden
items.description_source_text: A tactical game combining the turn-based combat of XCOM with story, exploration, stealth, and strategy. Take control of a team of Mutants navigating a post-human Earth. Created by a team including former HITMAN leads and the designer of PAYDAY.

offers.title: Mutant Year Zero: Road to Eden

items.title: One Piece Pirate Warriors 3
items.description_source_text: Enjoy the original story of ONE PIECE from Fuschia Village to the mysterious kingdom of Dressrosa. Will your resolution be strong enough to defeat the most dangerous pirates, including Doflamingo and many more?

items.title: RPG Time: The Legend of Wright
items.description_source_text: It's time for an adventure! Once classes are over, RPG Time begins! Game master Kenta's notebook holds a handwritten RPG made just for you.

items.title: SOULCALIBUR VI
items.description_source_text: Bring more than your fists to the fight! Featuring all-new battle mechanics and characters, SOULCALIBUR VI marks a new era of the historic franchise. Welcome back to the stage of history!

items.title: Tacoma
items.description_source_text: Tacoma is a sci-fi narrative adventure from the creators of Gone Home. Set aboard a high-tech space station in the year 2088, explore every detail of how the station’s crew lived and worked, finding the clues that add up to a gripping story of trust, fear, and resolve in the face of disaster.

items.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV STEAM EDITION
items.description_source_text: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV finally hits STEAM! KOF XIV is back with its classic 2D gameplay and "3-on-3 TEAM BATTLE" game system but evolved to 3D! 58 charismatic fighters are about to clash in this new chapter of KOF!

offers.title: THE KING OF FIGHTERS XIV STEAM EDITION ULTIMATE PACK

items.title: Worms Clan Wars
items.description_source_text: Worms™ Clan Wars is the biggest and best Worms™ game to date - more worms, larger landscapes, more dynamic water, more weapons and more customisation items than ever before.

items.title: Worms Revolution
items.description_source_text: Worms™ Revolution is the latest game in the classic turn-based strategy series to come to the PC.

items.title: Assassin's Creed Valhalla
items.description_source_text: Assassin’s Creed Valhalla is an action-adventure game in which you are a Viking warrior raised on tales of battle and glory. Explore a dynamic open world set in England’s Dark Ages. Raid your enemies and grow your settlement to earn your place among the gods in Valhalla.

items.title: Assassin's Creed® Odyssey
items.description_source_text: In this action-adventure game, set sail for Ancient Greece to alter its fate. Fight in visceral battles on land and sea, shape your destiny from outcast to legend, and uncover secrets of your past.

items.title: Company of Heroes 2
items.description_source_text: Experience the ultimate WWII RTS platform with COH2 and its standalone expansions. This package includes the base game, which you can then upgrade by purchasing The Western Front Armies, Ardennes Assault and/or The British Forces. More info in the "About This Game" section below.

items.title: Isonzo
items.description_source_text: Ferocious Alpine warfare will test your tactical skills in this authentic WW1 FPS. Battle among the scenic peaks, rugged valleys and idyllic towns of northern Italy. The Great War on the Italian Front is brought to life and elevated to unexpected heights!

items.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R
items.description_source_text: Hirohiko Araki's masterpiece, brought to life as a fighting game! Battle with 50 colorful characters, wielding Stands, Hamon, and more! See how characters who could never meet in the story interact when they come face to face!

offers.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: All-Star Battle R

items.title: Lifeless Planet Premier Edition
items.description_source_text: PREMIER EDITION - While seeking life on a distant planet, an astronaut discovers an abandoned Russian town. He suspects his mission is a hoax until a mysterious young woman saves him from a strange and deadly phenomenon... Lifeless Planet is a third-person action-adventure that features an old-school sci-fi story and spectacular environments in the spirit of classic action-adventures.

items.title: Little Nightmares
items.description_source_text: Take on the role of Six, a lone child lost in a massive metal vessel known as the Maw, surrounded by dangerous, distorted versions of adults. You’ll need to do your best to escape in one piece or your fate will be worse than you ever dared dream.

offers.title: Little Nightmares - Secrets of The Maw Expansion Pass

items.title: Sheltered
items.description_source_text: Sheltered is a deep and emotional survival management game. You take on the role of protecting four family members who, after a global apocalypse, have found their way to a deserted shelter.

items.title: WRC 7 FIA World Rally Championship
items.description_source_text: Take on all the challenges of the 2017 World Rally Championship: the official cars and drivers, 13 countries, 52 Special Stages, every surface, more powerful cars, more demanding physics, longer races, and an eSports mode to keep you on the edge of your seat all year round.

items.title: Alba: A Wildlife Adventure
items.description_source_text: Even the smallest person can make a big difference. Join Alba, as she sets out to save her beautiful island and its wildlife. And possibly start a revolution.

items.title: Anno 2070™
items.description_source_text: Build your society of the future, colonize islands, and create sprawling megacities with multitudes of buildings, vehicles, and resources to manage.

items.title: Assassin's Creed Freedom Cry
items.description_source_text: Play as Adewale, an ex-slave turned Assassin fighting for freedom with the help of his own Pirate crew.

items.title: Assassin’s Creed® Brotherhood
items.description_source_text: It’s time to join the Brotherhood.

items.title: Assassin’s Creed® Rogue
items.description_source_text: Introducing Assassin’s Creed® Rogue, the darkest chapter in the Assassin’s Creed franchise yet. As Shay, you will experience the slow transformation from Assassin to Assassin Hunter. Follow your own creed and set off on an extraordinary journey through New York City, the wild river valley, and far away to the icy cold waters of the North Atlantic in pursuit of your ultimate goal - bringing down the Assassins for good.

items.title: Between Horizons – A Sci-Fi Detective Adventure
items.description_source_text: Between Horizons is a narrative 2.5D sci-fi detective adventure. 33 years into the Zephyr's journey, its mission is suddenly jeopardized. Can you find the culprit before it's too late? Experience an enthralling story set in a semi-open world that branches and ends based on your choices.

items.title: Blazing Sails
items.description_source_text: Fight for survival in Blazing Sails, a fast-paced pirate PvP game! Create your own unique pirate and ship. Band together with other players to command your mighty vessel! Explore different game-modes, maps, weapons, ship types and more while eliminating other crews in epic battles on land and sea!

items.title: Company of Heroes
items.description_source_text: Delivering a visceral WWII gaming experience, Company of Heroes redefines RTS by bringing the sacrifice of heroic soldiers, war-ravaged environments, and dynamic battlefields to life. items.description_source_text: Five Dates is an interactive rom-com about the unpredictable world of digital dating. With five potential female matches, Vinny explores whether compatibility, chemistry and connection is still possible in a world where physical touch is no longer an option.

items.title: Guacamelee! Gold Edition
items.description_source_text: Guacamelee! is a Metroidvania-style action-platformer set in a magical Mexican-inspired world. The game draws its inspiration from traditional Mexican culture and folklore, and features many interesting and unique characters.

items.description_source_text: The most popular Heroes® title of all time is back in HD! items.description_source_text: Take your rightful place on the throne in this multiplayer-only party game for 4+ players. Rule the kingdom with an iron fist or silver tongue as you steer through bloodshed, intrigue & madcap disaster! Can you keep your crown when others plot your downfall? More importantly, can you keep your head?

items.title: Late Shift
items.description_source_text: Late Shift is a high stakes FMV crime thriller. Forced into a brutal London heist, your choices matter in this interactive cinematic experience with adaptable storylines that lead to one of seven conclusions. Your decisions are you.

items.title: Nexomon: Extinction
items.description_source_text: Nexomon: Extinction is a return to classic monster catching games, with a brand new story, eccentric characters and over 300 unique Nexomon to trap, tame and evolve.

items.title: Orcs Must Die! 3
items.description_source_text: Slice, burn, toss, zap, grind and gib massive hordes of repugnant orcs in this long-awaited successor to the award-winning Orcs Must Die! series.

items.title: The Escapists 2
items.description_source_text: Craft, Steal, Brawl and Escape! It’s time to bust out of the toughest prisons in the world as you return to the life of an inmate in The Escapists 2, now with multiplayer! Have you got what it takes to escape?

items.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell®
items.description_source_text: Enter the world of cinematic stealth action with Splinter Cell, the game that propelled the genre to cult status. You are Sam Fisher, an elite covert agent in the NSA's top-secret division: Third Echelon.

items.title: Tom Clancy’s Splinter Cell Blacklist
items.description_source_text: In this stealth-action thriller, a terrorist group known as the Engineers launches the Blacklist, a series of escalating attacks on US interests. Only one man can stop them: legendary covert agent Sam Fisher.

offers.title: Tom Clancy's Splinter Cell Blacklist Standard Edition

items.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War™ / Soldats Inconnus : Mémoires de la Grande Guerre™
items.description_source_text: Valiant Hearts : The Great War is the story of 4 crossed destinies and a broken love in a world torn apart. Dive into a 2D animated comic book adventure, mixing exploration, action and puzzles. Lost in the middle of the trenches, play as each of the 4 strangers, relive the War and help a young German soldier find his love.

offers.title: Valiant Hearts: The Great War / Soldats Inconnus : Mémoires de la Grande Guerre™

items.title: Whispers of a Machine
items.description_source_text: Whispers of a Machine is a Sci-Fi Nordic Noir that tells the story of Vera, a cybernetically augmented detective in a post-AI world, who investigates a string of murders and unravels a dark conflict over forbidden technology.

items.title: Minoria
items.description_source_text: Ink and blood stain the streets of Ramezia. Witches must burn and sins must be judged. Venture forth as Sister Semilla to burn down the pillars of heresy in Minoria, an action-platformer by Bombservice, creators of Momodora.

items.title: NieR:Automata™
items.description_source_text: NieR: Automata tells the story of androids 2B, 9S and A2 and their battle to reclaim the machine-driven dystopia overrun by powerful machines.

items.description_source_text: Planet Coaster® - the future of coaster park simulation games has arrived! Surprise, delight and thrill incredible crowds as you build your coaster park empire - let your imagination run wild, and share your success with the world.

items.title: South Park™: The Fractured But Whole™
items.description_source_text: From the creators of South Park, Trey Parker and Matt Stone, comes South Park: The Fractured But Whole, a sequel to 2014's award-winning South Park: The Stick of Truth.

items.title: Sovereign Syndicate
items.description_source_text: A Victorian steampunk RPG with tarot cards instead of dice. Investigate the disappearance of society’s most vulnerable to uncover a mysterious cult. Play as three characters, each with their own skills and motivations. Customize your characters with narrative choices to unlock new tarot cards.

items.title: The Longest Journey
items.description_source_text: The Longest Journey is an amazing graphical adventure, where the player controls the protagonist, April Ryan, on her journey between parallel universes.

items.title: 11-11 Memories Retold
items.description_source_text: 11th November 1916, a young photographer leaves Canada to join the western front in Europe. The same day, a German technician is told that his son is missing in action. Both want to preserve their humanity and come back alive to their loved ones.

items.title: Anno 1800
items.description_source_text: Anno 1800™ – Lead the Industrial Revolution! Welcome to the dawn of the Industrial Age. The path you choose will define your world. Are you an innovator or an exploiter? A conqueror or a liberator? How the world remembers your name is up to you.

items.title: Bloomtown: A Different Story
items.description_source_text: Bloomtown: A Different Story is a narrative JRPG mixing turn-based combat, monster taming and social RPG set in a seemingly pleasant 1960s Americana world. Join Emily and her group of friends to save their cozy town from the demonic creatures that live in the hearts of its residents!

items.title: Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour
items.description_source_text: Frag like it’s 1996 – this time with even more asses to kick! Join the world’s greatest action hero in Duke Nukem 3D: 20th Anniversary World Tour as he saves Earth once again, kicking alien ass and saving babes across the globe along the way.

items.title: If My Heart Had Wings
items.description_source_text: An animated visual novel of a lovely and bittersweet tale of youth, you play as Aoi Minase in this romantic-comedy as he meets various young girls in his hometown and works together with them to revive their school’s glider-flying “Soaring Club” in order to realize their shared dream of flight.

items.title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel
items.description_source_text: Hordes of Hel is a gripping roguelike horde-survivor game set in the dark realms of Norse Mythology. Fight waves of enemies to earn divine blessings of ancient Viking Deities, explore hostile worlds and face powerful bosses. Become a god-like warrior in this ultimate showdown.

offers.title: Jotunnslayer: Hordes of Hel & Pinball Storm: Lokanta

items.title: Jurassic World Evolution
items.description_source_text: Place yourself at the heart of the Jurassic franchise and build your own Jurassic World. Bioengineer dinosaurs that think, feel and react intelligently to the world around them and face threats posed by espionage, breakouts and devastating tropical storms in an uncertain world where life always finds a way.

items.title: Lacuna – A Sci-Fi Noir Adventure
items.description_source_text: A murder. A hack. A bombing. All it takes to plunge the solar system into war – unless you do something about it. Help CDI agent Neil Conrad make a string of increasingly difficult decisions in this modern dialog-driven adventure set in a gorgeous 2D sci-fi noir universe.
